# Everything the `site-browser` job in ci.yml installs, pinned and hashed. pip runs with
# --require-hashes, so a wheel that does not match the digest PyPI published for it is
# refused before any of its code runs. Each entry lists every file PyPI holds for that
# version, so whichever wheel suits the runner is covered. Regenerate the whole file, with
# its digests, when a version moves; tests/test_workflows.py checks that playwright and
# pytest here match PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION and PYTEST_VERSION in ci.yml.
